puzzles.description: Enter the 4-digit case reference number from the escalation email.
hints: The escalation email subject contains a case reference. Look at the last 4 digits.
Reference format is CR-YYYY-NNNN. Enter only the final 4-digit sequence.

puzzles.description: Review the transaction records you've collected and identify the connected transaction that breaches the disclosure threshold.

config.title: 📋 Connected Transaction Breach Analysis

clauses.text: Under Chapter 14A, a connected transaction requires mandatory disclosure when it exceeds ___ of the issuer's market capitalisation.
The transaction that breaches the disclosure threshold is ___.
The breach ratio for this transaction is approximately ___.

falseOutputs: Incorrect. Re-check the transaction amounts against market capitalisation. The threshold is clear — one transaction exceeds it.

hints: Calculate each transaction as: Amount ÷ Market Cap × 100. Which one exceeds the threshold?

puzzles.description: Match each person to their role in the breach. One approved it, one was kept in the dark, one was told late.

falseOutputs: Incorrect. Re-read the statements — who contradicts whom?
Wrong. Focus on the timeline gap.

hints: Finance says Tuesday. Compliance says Finance told them Thursday. That's a 2-day gap.

puzzles.description: Complete the breach notification form. All fields must be correct for submission.

config.title: 📋 Breach Notification — Form BN-14A

clauses.text: Mandatory reporting deadline from date of discovery: ___.

falseOutputs: FILING REJECTED — One or more fields are incorrect. The Exchange requires accurate classification. Review your evidence and re-submit.

hints: The transaction involved a connected party — which chapter covers that?
Finance approved it Tuesday but told Compliance on Thursday. That 2-day gap isn't negligence — it's deliberate.
Ch.14 Notifiable Transactions, Major (over 5%), Concealment, 2 business days.
